Parts.Description: Golden sand all over the cove and a blue lagoon with a wet shore for the ship.
Parts.Name: Cove Sand and Lagoon

Parts.Description: A huge dark wood galleon with a pointed bow, planked decks, rails and a tall stern castle.
Parts.Name: Galleon Hull

Parts.Description: A big black board on two posts, a skull on top and GET BONKED in bone white letters.
Parts.Name: Get Bonked Sign

Parts.Description: A tall main mast with a crow's nest, a fore mast, a mizzen mast and a bowsprit.
Parts.Name: Masts and Yards

Parts.Description: A wooden pier from the ship to the Shiba with mooring posts, ropes, barrels and a lantern.
Parts.Name: Gangplank Pier

Parts.Description: Big cream sails with red stripes on all three masts and a jib at the bow.
Parts.Name: Cream Sails

Parts.Description: A two storey pirate tavern with a red roof, a porch, rum barrels and a hanging sign.
Parts.Name: Rum Tavern

Parts.Description: Six black cannons on wooden carriages, three along each side, plus a pile of cannonballs.
Parts.Name: Deck Cannons

Parts.Description: A cream tent, a campfire with log seats, barrels and a stack of crates on the beach.
Parts.Name: Pirate Camp

Parts.Description: A black skull and crossbones flag on the top of the main mast and red pennants on the other masts.
Parts.Name: Jolly Roger

Parts.Description: Three leaning palm trees with coconuts on the right side of the beach.
Parts.Name: Palm Grove

Parts.Description: A little rowboat pulled up on the sand with two oars and a rusty anchor.
Parts.Name: Beached Rowboat

Parts.Description: A giant chest with a round lid and gold bands, piles of gold coins, a goblet and a skull.
Parts.Name: Treasure Hoard

Parts.Description: A grey rock in the lagoon shaped like a giant skull with dark eyes, a toothy grin and a pirate hat.
Parts.Name: Skull Rock

Parts.Description: A purple sea monster with big yellow eyes and four huge tentacles rising out of the lagoon.
Parts.Name: The Kraken
